name: 宿主转移
description: 选择其他棋子（7），与其换位，并对敌方目标施加定身[1]。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 7, filter: 'all' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; if (target.instanceId === caster.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '宿主转移不能选择毒液自身' }; if (target.currentHp <= 0 || target.x == null || target.y == null || caster.x == null || caster.y == null) return { success: false, message: '宿主转移只能选择场上的存活角色' }; if (Math.abs(caster.x - target.x) + Math.abs(caster.y - target.y) > 7) return { success: false, message: '目标距离超过7格' }; var x = caster.x; var y = caster.y; if (!flow.effects.move([{pieceId:caster.instanceId,x:target.x,y:target.y},{pieceId:target.instanceId,x:x,y:y}], 'swap').success) return {success:true,message:'换位被阻挡，双方保持原位'}; if (!arePlayersAllied(battle, target.ownerPlayerId, caster.ownerPlayerId)) { addStatusEffectById(target.instanceId, { id: 'root-' + caster.instanceId + '-' + target.instanceId, name: '定身', type: 'root', currentDuration: 1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, sourceId: caster.instanceId }); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '发动宿主转移，与' + target.name + '交换位置' + (!arePlayersAllied(battle, target.ownerPlayerId, caster.ownerPlayerId) ? '并使其定身1回合' : '') }; }
